sourceState: read-only candidate working tree including pinned staged patch; exact selected fingerprints
scope: Four document-purpose workflows, scoped symmetric document leaves, borrowed native Ed25519 signer; no wire/algorithm/version changes.
adaptations: Use public opaque ledger view and fixed verifier instead of injected ContentAuthority/ContentCrypto verification.
Reuse merged v0 format/HKDF/XChaCha20 primitives; generic key material helpers remain package-internal.
Document keys have private registry provenance; exported/imported symmetric leaf bytes are copied.
Check current seal permission before encryption and after signing; historical author authentication never grants publication rights.
Native signer borrows a CryptoKey, awaits native completion on interruption, cleans scratch with ordinary finally, and creates no runtime/key/store.
Operations read inputs on Effect execution; input stability is an explicit caller contract.
Generic non-document scopes, ledger command signing, key installation/commitment checks and SDK workflows remain separately owned, not silently removed.
